definitions.gloss: to take medicine; to administer orally
definitions.explanation: To take medicine by mouth. A formal word used in medical and pharmaceutical contexts for oral medication.

examples.japanese: {薬|くすり}を{服用|ふくよう}する。
{食後|しょくご}に{一錠|いちじょう}{服用|ふくよう}してください。
examples.english: Please take one tablet after meals.

examples.japanese: この{薬|くすり}は{長期|ちょうき}{服用|ふくよう}すると{副作用|ふくさよう}が{出|で}ることがある。
examples.english: Long-term use of this medicine can cause side effects.

notes:
A formal, medical term for taking medication orally. Found on medicine packaging, in doctor's instructions, and in pharmaceutical literature.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {服用|ふくよう}{量|りょう}: dosage
- {服用|ふくよう}{方法|ほうほう}: how to take (the medicine)
- {服用|ふくよう}{期間|きかん}: period of administration
- {長期|ちょうき}{服用|ふくよう}: long-term use
- {食前|しょくぜん}/{食後|しょくご}に{服用|ふくよう}: take before/after meals

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {飲|の}む: to drink/take (medicine) — everyday, conversational
- {投与|とうよ}する: to administer (medicine) — from the doctor/nurse's perspective
- {摂取|せっしゅ}する: to ingest — broader, includes food and nutrients

REGISTER:
More formal than {飲|の}む. In daily conversation, people say {薬|くすり}を{飲|の}む rather than {服用|ふくよう}する. {服用|ふくよう} appears on prescription labels, medicine inserts, and in medical instructions.
